mapper.select: SELECT a.*, au.real_name AS auditor_name, u.real_name AS student_name, act.activity_name FROM Audit a LEFT JOIN User au ON a.auditor_id = au.user_id LEFT JOIN Registration r ON a.register_id = r.register_id LEFT JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN Activity act ON r.activity_id = act.activity_id WHERE a.audit_id = #{auditId}
